text.p: Rogers Cantel Mobile Communications Inc and AT&T Corp's Canadian unit said on Wednesday that they formed a long-term strategic alliance that included the licensing of AT&T brands to Rogers Cantel.
The deal also included a technology and marketing pact with AT&T Wireless Services.

The companies said the agreement involved royalty payments, the issue of Rogers Cantel warrants and payments to AT&T for marketing and technical support. The warrants are exchangeable one-for-one over several years for C$32.5 million of Rogers Cantel class B shares issued from treasury.
A representative from AT&T Wireless will sit on Rogers Cantel's board.
The companies said the agreement would offer U.S. and Canadian customers of both companies seamless wireless communications. The services will sold under the Cantel AT&T name.
AT&T Canada and AT&T Wireless are units of AT&T Corp.
